batchRequest.request: Mark the second milestone as done and add a new risk.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, healthRow, stepsHeader, milestones, risksHeader, risksTable])
header = CardHeader("Project Phoenix: Status Report", "Reporting period: Q3 2025, Week 12")
healthRow = Stack([healthLabel, healthTag], "row", "s", "center")
healthLabel = TextContent("Overall Health:", "large-heavy")
healthTag = Tag("At Risk", warnIcon, "lg", "warning")
warnIcon = Icon("triangle-alert", "status")
stepsHeader = InlineHeader("Milestones", "Progress against the delivery plan")
milestones = Steps([m1, m2, m3, m4, m5])
m1 = StepsItem("Discovery & Requirements (Complete)", "Stakeholder interviews finished and requirements signed off on June 6.")
m2 = StepsItem("Architecture & Design (Complete)", "System design approved; UX prototypes validated with 12 users.")
m3 = StepsItem("Core Development (In Progress, 70%)", "Backend APIs done; front-end integration is running about one week behind schedule.")
m4 = StepsItem("UAT & Performance Testing (Upcoming)", "Scheduled to begin September 15, pending completion of core development.")
m5 = StepsItem("Launch & Handover (Planned)", "Target go-live October 20, with a two-week hypercare period afterwards.")
risksHeader = InlineHeader("Key Risks", "Ranked by severity")
risksTable = Table([Col("Risk", riskNames), Col("Severity", severityTags), Col("Owner", owners), Col("Mitigation", mitigations)])
riskNames = ["Front-end integration delay", "Third-party API instability", "Key engineer attrition", "Budget overrun on cloud costs"]
severityTags = [Tag("High", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("High", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Medium", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Low", null, "sm", "neutral")]
owners = ["Dana Ortiz", "Priya Nair", "Marcus Webb", "Elena Rossi"]
mitigations = ["Add two contractors; daily syncs", "Build fallback caching layer", "Cross-train team; document modules", "Weekly cost review; set budget alerts"]
request: Mark the second milestone as done and add a new risk.
